remarks: High-end, freshly painted Townhouse. 3-bedroom, 4 full and 1/2 bath front unit with high ceilings and hardwood floors throughout. Gourmet eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, stainless appliances and Sub Zero refrigerator. Two 2nd floor bedrooms with en-suite baths and cathedral ceilings. Second floor laundry room. Large gallery 2nd floor hallway, ideal for use as an office space. Flexible floor plan: 1st floor bedroom possibility with full bath and additional 1,045 sqft lower level, including full bath and 3rd bedroom. Three off-street, reserved parking spaces. Front of a 2-unit condo. Quiet one-way street in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Convenient to everything: Greenwich Avenue, the train, shopping, restaurants, the YMCA, public transportation and more. Starbucks & Whole Foods right around the corner.
